name: Cup no Soko ni Shizumu Mono
original_name: カップの底に沈むもの
source:
Akito, a student who has stopped attending school, spends his days in a quiet, cozy café. There, he shares casual conversations with his senior, Sayoko, amidst the peaceful hours spent across the counter. 

A story about savoring happiness and gently relishing it, wrapped in a little warmth.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12451]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
秋人是一名辍学的学生，他在一家安静舒适的咖啡馆里度过了他的日子。在那里，他在柜台对面度过了平静的时光，与他的前辈小代子进行了随意的交谈。

一个关于品味幸福、轻轻品味幸福、包裹着一点温暖的故事。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12451]Novelgame[/url]]
